verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has no native prompt-to-workflow builder. Because workflows are plain TypeScript tasks, users can generate or edit them through external AI coding assistants. Trigger.dev supports that path with Skills (portable instruction sets that teach assistants to use Trigger.dev) and an official MCP server that can search docs, initialize projects and deploy. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language workflow generation or editing feature, documentation showing prompt-driven creation or editing of tasks end to end, and independent or hands-on evidence of AI-generated workflows working in practice.
